# Future Ammunition - MPP

`ghost_fa_mpp`

Future Ammunition in the MPP pistols' own magazines - each pistol's stick filled with the FA round of its calibre (9x19, 5.7, .45 ACP) and put in that pistol's well. Generated by `tools/gen_fa_mcc.py`. Loads only with MPP.

<!-- generated below this line by tools/gen_addon_readmes.py - do not edit -->

## Requires

- `cba_main` _(external)_
- `ace_ballistics` _(external)_
- `ghost_fa_ammo`
- `ghost_fa_extracal`
- `MPP_PISTOLS` _(external)_

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
